title: Case Resolution of 'Southeast Asia Triangles'
doc_notes: This document is an AARO case resolution report regarding unidentified objects identified as fishing nets in Southeast Asia, with pages 2 and 3 containing only administrative markings.

incidents.summary: Six triangular objects observed in Southeast Asia via satellite imagery, initially flagged as potentially anomalous.
incidents.explanation: Cone-shaped static fishing nets floating on the surface of the ocean.
incidents.quote: Six triangular objects in a formation were originally flagged as potentially anomalous
